hunks.baseline: And so the day slipped away, and there was nothing I could do about it. Today was the long-awaited departure ceremony.
hunks.sol: And so an entire day slipped helplessly away. Today was the long-awaited departure ceremony.

hunks.baseline: As I muttered the curse under my breath, Jin Wikyung was climbing onto the platform.
hunks.sol: As I muttered the curse under my breath, Jin Wikyung climbed onto the platform.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of pairs of eyes followed him. Martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and martial artists from the small and mid-sized sects that had newly joined us. More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the Grand Training Ground.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of pairs of eyes followed him. The martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and those from the small and mid-sized sects that had recently joined us stood in formation across the Grand Training Ground, more than five hundred strong.

hunks.baseline: At some point, a tremendous rumble spread through the air. Some stamped their feet; others struck their weapons. When five hundred martial artists with internal energy moved as one, the earth shook and a roar filled heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A tremendous rumble began to spread. Some stamped their feet; others struck their weapons. When five hundred martial artists with internal energy moved as one, the earth shook and a deafening roar filled heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: *What is this…?*
hunks.sol: *What the…?*

hunks.baseline: I had never seen anything like it. They had gone from individuals to a single military force, and now they were waiting for one man’s command.
hunks.sol: I had never seen anything like it. No longer individuals, they had become a single army, waiting for one man’s command.

hunks.sol: The air crackled beneath his fiery shout. For that moment, even I felt my blood begin to boil.

hunks.sol: That was why the small and mid-sized sects of Shanxi Province, which had only watched from the sidelines while the two great powers fought, had sent reinforcements.

hunks.baseline: Fifteen hundred martial artists would clash at the same hour on the same day.

hunks.baseline: It would be a hellish fight in which they killed and were killed.

hunks.baseline: “We will surely win.”
hunks.sol: “We will prevail.”

hunks.sol: The next moment, a roar erupted loud enough to leave my ears ringing. With the crowd’s fervor at its peak, Jin Wikyung towered over them like a giant.

hunks.baseline: “Survival of the fittest! Fight with your lives on the line, and survive!”
hunks.sol: “Survival of the fittest! Put your lives on the line, fight, and survive!”

hunks.sol: Our five hundred troops were divided into the vanguard, center, and rear guard. Most of our core fighting strength had been assigned to the vanguard and center, so the rear guard under my command consisted of only a few dozen martial artists.

hunks.baseline: He was right. There was only one rude bastard on the reconnaissance squad.
hunks.sol: Right. There was only one bastard on the reconnaissance squad rude enough to answer like that.

hunks.sol: “You can’t even recognize my face anymore?”

hunks.baseline: No. Before that—why was this bastard here?

hunks.sol: Night came early in winter. The sun set, and after we had walked for who knew how long, we finally entered a broad basin and received the order to make camp.

hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin groaned. He clearly hadn’t fully recovered, and the march seemed to be taking its toll.

hunks.sol: “It’s not too late. Want to turn back?”

hunks.sol: “You’re imagining things. Does Hyuk Mujin the man look like someone who’d be exhausted after walking for a mere half day?”

hunks.sol: “Then go help the others set up camp.”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Hyuk Mujin the man snapped his eyes wide and sank to the ground.
hunks.sol: At that moment, Hyuk Mujin the man’s eyes widened, and he sank to the ground.

hunks.sol: “Ugh, the internal injuries Jopil gave me…”

hunks.sol: *You said your internal injuries were completely healed, you bastard.*

hunks.sol: A huge shadow stretched beneath the moonlight. Hyuk Mujin cautiously raised his head to see who it was, and his eyes flew open.

hunks.sol: “Gasp! Lesser Family Head!”

hunks.baseline: His voice and eyes hit home with more seriousness than ever before.
hunks.sol: His voice and gaze carried a gravity that struck me more deeply than ever before.
